blocks.text: In this seventh book of the Church History, the great bishop of Alexandria, Dionysius, [^eusebius-church-history-iii-xii-1] shall again assist us by his own words; relating the several affairs of his time in the epistles which he has left. I will begin with them.

eusebius-church-history-iii-xii-1.text: On Dionysius, see especially Bk. VI. chap. 40, note 1.
